assumptions.entry: Next trading day's adjusted open after the report
assumptions.exit: Adjusted close on the first trading day on or after the calendar holding period
assumptions.allocation: Equal dollars per security and equal weight per report cohort
assumptions.window: Cohorts whose report date falls within the trailing window
assumptions.sharpe: Annualized from equal-weight daily cohort returns with a 0% risk-free rate
assumptions.kelly: Half-Kelly from absolute winners and losers; minimum 5 closed positions
